WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
agg AS (
  SELECT store_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' THEN net_sales END) AS fy2526,
    SUM(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-10-04' THEN net_sales END) AS fy2627_ytd,
    SUM(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-04-29' AND DATE '2025-04-27' THEN net_sales END) AS fy2425
  FROM net_lines GROUP BY 1)
SELECT a.store_id, c.store_name, c.sqm, c.format, ROUND(a.fy2526,0) fy2526, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.fy2526 DESC) r2526, ROUND(a.fy2627_ytd,0) ytd, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.fy2627_ytd DESC) rytd, ROUND(a.fy2425,0) fy2425, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.fy2425 DESC) r2425
FROM agg a JOIN dim_store c ON c.store_id=a.store_id AND c.is_current
ORDER BY fy2526 DESC

WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales) AS mine FROM net_lines WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' GROUP BY 1),
ctrl AS (SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales) AS ctrl FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' AND store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT m.store_id, ROUND(m.mine,2) mine, ROUND(c.ctrl,2) ctrl, ROUND(m.mine-c.ctrl,2) diff
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctrl c USING (store_id)
ORDER BY ABS(m.mine-c.ctrl) DESC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 15

WITH d AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1
)
SELECT s.store_id, MIN(f.sale_date) mind, MAX(f.sale_date) maxd, COUNT(*) n_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) receipts, SUM(f.net_amount) net, MIN(f.etl_loaded_at) l1, MAX(f.etl_loaded_at) l2, COUNT(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) loads
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no) JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH params AS (SELECT DATE '2025-04-28' AS start_date, DATE '2026-05-03' AS end_date),
sales_dedup AS (
    SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY etl_loaded_at, sales_line_id) = 1
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM sales_dedup f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n, params WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date GROUP BY 1),
ctrl AS (SELECT c.store_id, SUM(c.net_sales) AS ctrl FROM rpt_daily_store_sales c, params WHERE c.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND c.store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY m.net_sales DESC) AS rank, d.store_id, d.store_name, ROUND(m.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales, ROUND(m.net_sales - c.ctrl, 2) AS gap_to_control
FROM mine m JOIN ctrl c USING (store_id) JOIN dim_store d ON d.store_id = m.store_id AND d.is_current
ORDER BY rank LIMIT 13

WITH params AS (SELECT DATE '2025-04-28' AS start_date, DATE '2026-05-03' AS end_date),
sales_dedup AS (
    SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY etl_loaded_at, sales_line_id) = 1
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM sales_dedup f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
store_sales AS (
    SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales DESC) AS rank, d.store_id, d.store_name, ROUND(ss.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN dim_store d ON d.store_id = ss.store_id AND d.is_current
ORDER BY rank
LIMIT 10
